note: 'A Psalm of David' (Ps 23:1), which is the superscription the corpus supplies.
'These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David' (Rev 3:7).
'Jesus Christ, the son of David' (Matt 1:1); 'Hosanna to the Son of David!' (Matt 21:9).
'My servant David' (Ezek 34:23), long after his death.
'be their shepherd' (Ezek 34:23), closing a chapter that has spent twenty verses on shepherds who fed themselves.
'the key to the house of David' (Isa 22:22), which Revelation shortens.
'The LORD is my shepherd' (Ps 23:1), with the pasture and the still waters following.; The phrase 'my shepherd' uses the word shepherd as a figure.
Built on the man, and Matthew 22:42-45 makes the descent the puzzle rather than the credential.
'with you an everlasting covenant-My loving devotion promised to David' (Isa 55:3) -- the covenant is the thing being extended.
Named for him, and offered to others.
'your throne will be established forever' (2Sam 7:16) is the covenant the phrase rests on, and Jeremiah 33:17 restates it as a standing promise.
Named for him in the promise at 2 Samuel 7:16 and in every later use.
'The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David' (Luke 1:32), said of Jesus before his birth.
